title: The finite-word generator reduction interface
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a family of schemes and an input location map. The Operations record contains the actual strict-system and ordinary ringed-site operations and their prescribed quotient normalizations [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Word is the finite indexed syntax of inputs, scalar units, tensor, separated finite-type pullback, proper image and quasi-compact open extension. Its ringed, integral and system interpretations use exactly those operations; its completionMap is defined recursively by functoriality and the actual quotient-completion units. GeneratorKind lists precisely the structural generators of [lem-sf-generator-reduction-coherence]. The generator maps are the independently defined system and ringed maps, with the latter transported along completionMap using inverseOrZero [def-sf-comparison-inverse-or-zero]. Word.r is the recursive coefficient comparison, and Assertion is its commuting generator square. SystemAdmissible, Admissible, Word.admissible and lambdaAdmissible retain normalization, compatible etale origins, constructibility and the common cohomological and Tor bounds, without imposing conditions on unrelated words. These are the existing definitions, relocated verbatim to permit independent proofs to import the interface without importing their own consumer.
